summary: Tested the new Blender feature (backend and frontend) plus a nav and Compare-link regression check. Backend: 17/17 new pytest cases pass. Covered: /api/blend/sources structure and type averages; DM-weighted blend math checked against hand calculation; mass-weighted moisture; gum treated as 0 when missing; worst-status inheritance (5% FAIL lot gives FAIL, score 0); PASS+PASS blend; 5-component allergen union; 0.5% tolerance; 422 validation for sum, duplicates, 0%, unknown id, >100 or negative, more than 5 or fewer than 2 components, empty body. Frontend: defaults (guar 60 / pulse 40) render the score, usable protein, status, allergens, table, contribution and score charts. Also checked: the sum error message, Scale to 100%, Add component (0% gives an error), Equal split (33.4/33.3/33.3), disabling of already-used options, switching to a FAIL sample (status FAIL, score 0), the slider syncing with the number input, remove (disabled at 2 components), Add disabled at 5, the Compare 'Try mixing in the Blender' link, and sidebar nav. No page errors. Found 1 real data bug (samples with no values) and 1 mobile layout overflow.

minor.issue: A sample with no predictions or lab values (e.g. created via POST /api/samples without a spectrum) appears in /api/blend/sources with values={} and is accepted in a blend. Reproduced with TEST sample 50% + type:guar_meal 50%. Result: the blend reports protein 48.73, which is pure guar (the empty component is silently dropped from DM-weighted keys). Moisture is halved (missing moisture is treated as 0). contribution_shares arrays have length 1 instead of 2, so the frontend (which indexes shares by component position) credits 100% of protein/oil/etc. to component 0, the empty sample. Fix: exclude sources with no composition values from sources(), or return 422 when a component lacks protein/moisture. Also always emit shares aligned to the components list (0 for missing).

Performance: every call runs rules.build_report for all samples. POST /api/blend calls sources() again, and the UI posts on every slider change (300ms debounce). Fine for about 20 samples but O(N) per keystroke.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px the page scrolls horizontally (document scrollWidth 618px). The outer grid (`grid gap-6 xl:grid-cols-[420px_1fr]`) has no explicit columns below xl, and the grid items keep min-width:auto, so the table's min-w-[560px] and the Plotly charts widen the column. Cards and recipe controls are cut off on the right, and charts overflow their sections. Fix: add `grid-cols-1` to the grid, or `min-w-0` to both column divs (the table already sits in overflow-x-auto).

issues: X-axis labels are long and rotated, and get truncated ('Pulse-processing residue a...'). With 5 components the labels crowd together; use short names or the component colour legend.
api.get('/blend/sources') has no .catch, so a backend error leaves the skeleton spinning forever with no error message.

The sliders are independent: moving one does not rebalance the others, so the total often jumps to e.g. 146.6% and needs 'Scale to 100%'. This is acceptable, but the last valid result stays on screen (only dimmed) while the error shows.

action_items: blend.py: exclude sources with no composition values (or 422 when a component lacks protein/moisture), and keep contribution_shares aligned to the component order (0 for missing)
Blender.jsx: fix mobile horizontal overflow by adding grid-cols-1 or min-w-0 on the grid columns
Blender.jsx: add a .catch on the /blend/sources fetch with an error state
Optional: shorten the score-chart x labels; cache sources per request in blend()
critical_code_review_comments: blend.py blend(): `have` filtering drops components missing a key, but shares are indexed by position in `have`, not by component. This misaligns with the frontend's res.contribution_shares[k][i]
blend.py: moisture uses s['values'].get('moisture', 0), so a missing moisture is silently treated as 0% (and DM weight becomes 100%)
Blender.jsx ComponentRow uses key={i}, which is fine because the rows are controlled, but a stable id would be cleaner
Average-type sources are computed from build_report values, which mix lab-measured and predicted values. This is acceptable for a demo but undocumented

success_rate.backend: 100% (17/17); 1 data-edge bug found via manual repro
success_rate.frontend: about 90%: all desktop flows work; mobile overflow

seed_data_creation: Created TEST-BLND1 (supplier TEST_sup) to reproduce the empty-sample bug, then deleted it directly from SQLite (SQLITE_PATH from backend/.env). No seeded data was modified.

To reproduce the empty-sample bug: POST /api/samples without a spectrum, then blend it 50/50 with type:guar_meal.
